page_title: MCI 2-2 CRY | Manchester City v Crystal Palace 16/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+8' Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
90+8' Paul Tierney blows for a foul after Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Crystal Palace will take a free kick near the side line.
90+6' Rico Lewis comes off the pitch to be replaced by John Stones (Manchester City).
90+5' 2 - 2 Goal! Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Ederson into the bottom left corner.
90+5' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
90+3' Paul Tierney blows his whistle after Phil Foden (Manchester City) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. It's a penalty! What an opportunity to score for Crystal Palace.
90+3' Matheus Franca (Crystal Palace) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
90+1' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Nathaniel Clyne as he is replaced by Eberechi Eze (Crystal Palace).
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.

88' Naouirou Ahamada (Crystal Palace) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Manchester City will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
87' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper.
84' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
81' Here is a change. Jeffrey Schlupp is going off and Roy Hodgson gives the last tactical orders to Matheus Franca (Crystal Palace).
81' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Naouirou Ahamada (Crystal Palace) is coming onto the pitch as Jairo Riedewald cannot continue after picking up an injury.
79' Manchester City control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
76' 2 - 1 Goal! Jeffrey Schlupp feeds Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 2:1.
73' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
69' Manchester City hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
66' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
64' The resulting set piece from Manchester City is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

63' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the left side of the goal, but Dean Henderson thwarts him with a great two-handed save. The ball goes out of play. Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.
60' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Crystal Palace, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
58' Manchester City have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
57' Paul Tierney sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
56' The Manchester City players halt their celebrations as referee Paul Tierney makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
54' 2 - 0 Goal! Rico Lewis (Manchester City) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
53' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) has a goal ruled out for offside!
52' A player from Crystal Palace pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. Manchester City will take a free kick.
51' Manchester City are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
46' The whistle blows and Paul Tierney starts the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' The resulting corner from Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) is cleared by the defence.
45+4' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Crystal Palace, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Michael Olise (Crystal Palace) produces a shot from a direct free kick on the edge of the box. His effort sails narrowly over the crossbar. The goalkeeper was lucky there.
42' Ederson (Manchester City) takes out his opponent with a horrible challenge and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
41' Rodri (Manchester City) goes for goal with a shot from long range, but the effort flies painfully wide of the right post.
41' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Manchester City, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
40' Joachim Andersen (Crystal Palace) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Paul Tierney had an easy-decision to make.
38' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
36' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the left post.
36' Manchester City force their opponents to concede a corner.
36' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
34' Roy Hodgson is forced to make a change. Joel Ward (Crystal Palace) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by David Ozoh.
33' Joel Ward (Crystal Palace) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
31' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot at goal. His effort is blocked by Dean Henderson with a brilliant diving save!
29' Jean-Philippe Mateta (Crystal Palace) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
27' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Manchester City players have a reason to celebrate!
25' Wait! Referee Paul Tierney has indicated he is going to review the Manchester City goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
24' 1 - 0 Goal! Jack Grealish (Manchester City) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Phil Foden, then sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
18' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
17' The corner is swung in but Manchester City can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

16' Rodri (Manchester City) goes for goal and shoots towards the left side of the goal, but his effort is well blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Manchester City will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
13' Paul Tierney blows the whistle, Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) is penalised for a foul.
11' Rodri (Manchester City) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
10' Ruben Dias (Manchester City) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Dean Henderson scrambling, but it flies just wide of the left post.
7' Ruben Dias (Manchester City) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!
6' The ball goes out of play and Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.
6' The corner from Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) is cleared away by the defence.

5' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the left side of the goal. Dean Henderson shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net. Manchester City will take a corner kick.
3' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Manchester City are ruled offside.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Crystal Palace will take the kick-off.
Paul Tierney got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
